earlier_run.why_kept: The first recorder took the stop GDB reports for the connect as the stop of its own breakpoint, so the server it meant to terminate with the core halted was terminated while the core ran. The next server could not open the probe. The later run drains that stop and records both cases on purpose; there the start after a terminate while the core ran worked, so the failure below is intermittent.
